summary: building with a LOD: one main shell per volume meeting the ground, a roof with an overhang or parapet, an entrance with depth; standard adds ledges, recessed windows, gutters; hero adds roof clutter, signage, lamps and finished back facades. The LOD, collision and draw distance are the finish gate's.

overall.summary: the whole building, 3/4 views from the street

roof.summary: roof from above and the eaves

base.summary: where the walls meet the ground

notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.

items.name: Main massing
items.construction: one closed shell per volume, walls meeting the ground (no gap), storeys at about 3 m

items.name: Roof
items.construction: roof slab with an overhang or a parapet, or a pitched roof with eaves

items.name: Plinth or foundation band
items.construction: band where the walls meet the ground, slightly proud

items.name: Entrance
items.construction: door recess with a frame, a step or a porch

items.name: Window bays
items.construction: tiling facade texture with the windows aligned to the storeys (recessed frames at standard)

items.name: Facade textures
items.construction: tiling 128/256 textures on every facade, prelight baked (dark under eaves, at the base)

items.name: Ledges and cornices
items.construction: string courses and a cornice as extruded bands

items.name: Window recesses
items.construction: windows inset so the facade has depth (inset + extrude in)

items.name: Parapet coping or fascia
items.construction: coping on the parapet or a fascia on the eaves

items.name: Gutters and downpipes
items.construction: gutters along the eaves, downpipes swept to the ground

items.name: Porch or canopy
items.construction: canopy or porch roof over the entrance on posts or brackets

items.name: Back and side facades
items.construction: rear and side walls finished like the front: doors, vents, windows

items.name: Roof clutter
items.construction: AC units, vents, a water tank, antennas, a dish, an access hatch

items.name: Signage
items.construction: shop sign, house number, wall signs

items.name: Pipes, cables and meters
items.construction: pipes, conduits, a meter box on the walls

items.name: Awnings
items.construction: awnings over windows or shop fronts

items.name: Fences and steps
items.construction: fences, walls, steps and ramps on the plot

views_note: views name the close-up regions of 'blender preview --regions' (data/kit/regions/building.json) that show each region; 'overall' with no views = the standard preview sheet
